sources.prompt: Create one exquisite FULL COLOR Chinese manhua/gongbi narrative painting for Dream of the Red Chamber motion comic. Landscape 1536x1024, full bleed, no text, no logo, no watermark, no borders. Rich Qing-dynasty mineral azurite blue, malachite, antique gold and jade silk details. Lin Daiyu, delicate oval Chinese face, fine arched brows, traditional black chignon, celadon robe with ivory skirt and blush sash sits alone by a carved wood window in Xiaoxiangguan with lush bamboo outside. She holds a writing brush above blank rice paper, slender elegant hands, pensive luminous eyes looking out to new spring buds. A beautiful blue-white vase with white magnolia, books and pale curtain, soft daylight reflecting off water beyond. Camera looking into the room past softly unfocused bamboo leaves, her face at 56% x 37% y within central 60% for phone crop. Nuanced wistful anticipation, sophisticated cinematic depth, refined line drawing, exquisitely rendered silk. Pure literary atmosphere, no fire, no funeral, no modern objects, no sexualization.
